summary: Hikers about 9:30 a.m. discovered a deceased person near Pinewood Reservoir in the 15000 block of W. County Road 18E; LCSO, Larimer County Dept. of Natural Resources park rangers and LCSAR responded and carried out the body; the coroner took custody with no indication of foul play.
location: Pinewood Reservoir, 15000 blk W. County Rd 18E
responding_agency: Larimer County Sheriff's Office; Larimer County Dept. of Natural Resources park rangers; Larimer County SAR; Larimer County Coroner's Office
notes: Body discovery rather than witnessed rescue; index precedent exists for recovery rows. Run 651.
